description: Identifies a side panel of the TmEditorShell — the Left toolbox-style panel and the Right properties-style panel. Used by CollapsedPanels to render a panel as a slim rail instead of its full width, and by ActiveMobilePanel to name the panel a mobile layout shows.

members.name: None
members.description: No panel: nothing collapsed, or for ActiveMobilePanel the shell default (the canvas tab of the Tabs presentation, the first open panel of the sheet).

members.name: Left
members.description: The left panel (a toolbox, a block list, navigation).

members.name: Right
members.description: The right panel (an inspector, properties, event detail).
